description: Source file implementing a linear memory allocator for the fy-allocator framework, including setup, cleanup, allocation, deallocation, and informational functions.

methods.name: int fy_linear_setup(struct fy_allocator * a,const void * cfg_data)
methods.description: Initializes a linear allocator with provided configuration data, allocating buffer if not provided.

methods.name: void fy_linear_cleanup(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Cleans up the linear allocator, freeing allocated buffer.

methods.name: struct:fy_allocator * fy_linear_create(const void * cfg_data)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new linear allocator instance based on configuration data.

methods.name: void fy_linear_destroy(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Destroys a linear allocator instance, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: void fy_linear_dump(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Outputs the current state and statistics of the linear allocator.

methods.name: void * fy_linear_alloc(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,size_t size,size_t align)
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory with specified size and alignment from the linear allocator.

methods.name: void fy_linear_free(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,void * data)
methods.description: No-op for linear allocator; does not free individual allocations.

methods.name: int fy_linear_update_stats(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,struct fy_allocator_stats * stats)
const void * fy_linear_store(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const void * data,size_t size,size_t align)
methods.description: Stores data into newly allocated memory block.

methods.name: const void * fy_linear_storev(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const struct iovec * iov,int iovcnt,size_t align)
methods.description: Stores multiple buffers into memory, concatenating them.

methods.name: void fy_linear_release(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const void * data,size_t size)
int fy_linear_get_tag(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Returns a tag for the allocator; always 0 for linear.

methods.name: void fy_linear_release_tag(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: Resets the allocator's memory pointer to the start, effectively rewinding.

methods.name: struct:fy_allocator_info * fy_linear_get_info(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: Provides detailed info about the allocator's current state.
